## Pull request overview

This PR implements comprehensive GraphQL protocol specifications for ObjectStack, enabling auto-generation of type-safe GraphQL APIs from ObjectQL metadata with production-grade security controls.

**Changes:**
- Added complete GraphQL schema generation protocol with type mapping, query/mutation/subscription configurations, and resolver definitions
- Implemented security protocols including query depth limiting, complexity calculation, rate limiting, and persisted queries
- Generated JSON schemas and documentation for all GraphQL configurations

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 20 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/api/index.ts | Exports the new GraphQL module |
| packages/spec/src/api/graphql.zod.ts | Core GraphQL protocol definitions with 14 Zod schemas and helper functions |
| packages/spec/src/api/graphql.test.ts | Comprehensive test coverage with 77 test cases |
| packages/spec/json-schema/api/*.json | Auto-generated JSON schemas for all GraphQL configurations |
| content/docs/references/api/graphql.mdx | Auto-generated API documentation |
| content/docs/references/api/meta.json | Updated navigation to include GraphQL documentation |
| content/docs/references/api/index.mdx | Added GraphQL to API reference index |
</details>
